title: Ravana feels distressed over his son's death
introduction: Ravana feels distressed in hearing the news of his son's death. He gets enraged and after deeply pondering over, decides to kill Seetha, who was the root of all this trouble. Ravana with a sword in his hand, sallies forth towards Ashoka garden to make a short work of Seetha. Seetha observes Ravana rushing towards her and laments that after killing Rama and Lakshmana, he is coming to her place to kill her. Beholding the lamentation of Seetha, Suparshva, a good and upright minister of Ravana advises Ravana to desist from that dastardly act and to divert his anger towards Rama in battle. Ravana accepts the advice of his minister and returns to his assembly-hall.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्विनवतितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 92nd chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पौलस्त्य सचिवाः श्रुत्वा चेन्द्रजितं हतम् |
आचचक्षुरभिज्ञाय दशग्रीवाय सव्यथाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ paulastya sacivāḥ śrutvā cendrajitaṃ hatam |
ācacakṣurabhiGYāya daśagrīvāya savyathāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing of Indrajit's killing and having ascertained the news, Ravana's counsellors reported the matter hurriedly to Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
युद्धे हतो महाराज लक्ष्मणेन तवात्मजः |
विभीषणसहायेन मिषतां नो महाद्युते
verses.iast:
yuddhe hato mahārāja lakṣmaṇena tavātmajaḥ |
vibhīṣaṇasahāyena miṣatāṃ no mahādyute
verses.translation: "O monarch! Your great majestic son has been killed by Lakshmana with the help of Vibhishana, while we were witnessing the event in the battle-field."

glosses.meaning: while we were witnessing the same

verses.devanagari:
शूरः शूरेण संगम्य संयुगेष्वपराजितः |
लक्ष्णनेन हतः शूरः पुत्रस्ते विबुधेन्द्रजित्
गतः स परमान् लोकान् शरैः संताप्य् लक्ष्मणम् |
verses.iast:
śūraḥ śUreṇa saṅgamya saṃyugeṣvaparājitaḥ |
lakṣṇanena hataḥ śUraḥ putraste vibudhendrajit
gataḥ sa paramān lokān śaraiḥ santāpy lakṣmaṇam |
verses.translation: "Your valiant son, who was unbeatable in combats and that hero who conquered Indra the lord of celestials, having collided with valiant Lakshmana, has been killed. Having tormented Lakshmana with his arrows, Indrajit departed to the highest world."

glosses.meaning: who conquered Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
स तं प्रतिभयं श्रुत्वा वधं पुत्रस्य दारुणम्
घोरमिन्द्रजितः सङ्ख्ये कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत् |
verses.iast:
sa taṃ pratibhayaṃ śrutvā vadhaṃ putrasya dāruṇam
ghoramindrajitaḥ sañkhye kaśmalaṃ prāviśanmahat |
verses.translation: Hearing that news of formidable, harsh and terrific death of Indrajit his son in battle, Ravana gave way to a protracted swoon.

verses.devanagari:
उपलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां राजा राक्षसपुङ्गवः
पुत्रशोकाकुलो दीनो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः |
verses.iast:
upalabhya cirātsaṃGYāṃ rājā rākṣasapuñgavaḥ
putraśokākulo dIno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ |
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness after a long time, the king Ravana, confounded as he was with sorrow on account of his son's death and with his mind confused, lamented as follows depressed as he was.

glosses.meaning: confounded as he was with sorrow of his son's death

verses.devanagari:
हा राक्षसचमूमुख्य मम वत्स महारथ
जित्वेन्द्रं कथमद्य त्वं लक्ष्मणस्य वशं गतः |
verses.iast:
hā rākṣasacamUmukhya mama vatsa mahāratha
jitvendraṃ kathamadya tvaṃ lakṣmaṇasya vaśaṃ gataḥ |
verses.translation: "Alas! My child, the chief of the army of demons, having extraordinary might! Having conquered Indra, how have you been subjected to the power of Lakshmana now?"

glosses.meaning: O chief of the army of demons!
subjected to the will of Lakshmana?

verses.devanagari:
ननु त्वमिषुभिः क्रुद्धो भिन्द्याः कालान्तकावपि
मन्दरस्यापि शृङ्गाणि किं पुनर्लक्ष्मणं रणे |
verses.iast:
nanu tvamiṣubhiḥ kruddho bhindyāḥ kālāntakāvapi
mandarasyāpi śṛñgāṇi kiṃ punarlakṣmaṇaṃ raṇe |
verses.translation: "Certainly, when enraged, you would pierce with your arrows in battle, even the all-destroying time in the form of Yama the Lord of Death and even the peaks of Mount Mandara. What to tell about Lakshmana?"

glosses.meaning: even the all-destroying time in the form of Yama the lord of Death

verses.devanagari:
अद्य वैवस्वतो राजा भूयो बहुमतो मम
येनाद्य त्वं महाबाहो संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा |
verses.iast:
adya vaivasvato rājā bhUyo bahumato mama
yenādya tvaṃ mahābāho saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā |
verses.translation: "O the long armed one! Highly esteemed to me is the king Yama, son of sun-god, by whom you have been subjected to the ravages of time today."

glosses.meaning: O the long armed one! bhuuyaH bahumataH = highly esteemed mama = to me

verses.devanagari:
एष पन्थाः सुयोधानां सर्वामरगणेष्वपि
यः कृते हन्यते भर्तुः स पुमान् स्वर्गमृच्छति |
verses.iast:
eṣa panthāḥ suyodhānāṃ sarvāmaragaṇeṣvapi
yaḥ kṛte hanyate bhartuḥ sa pumān svargamṛcchati |
verses.translation: "This is the path for great warriors even among all the celestial hosts. That male offspring who is killed for the cause of his lord, obtains heaven."

glosses.meaning: even among all the celestial hosts
for the cause of his lord

verses.devanagari:
अद्य देवगणाः सर्वे लोकपालास्तथर्षयः
हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा सुखं स्वप्स्यन्ति निर्भयाः |
verses.iast:
adya devagaṇāḥ sarve lokapālāstatharṣayaḥ
hatamindrajitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhaṃ svapsyanti nirbhayāḥ |
verses.translation: "Seeing Indrajit having been killed, all the hosts of celestials, the guardians of the world and the great sages now can sleep comfortably and peacefully."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य लोकास्त्रयः कृत्स्नाः पृथिवी च सकानना
एकेनेन्द्रजिता हीना शूण्येव प्रतिभाति मे |
verses.iast:
adya lokāstrayaḥ kṛtsnāḥ pṛthivI ca sakānanā
ekenendrajitā hInā śUṇyeva pratibhāti me |
verses.translation: "Bereft of Indrajit alone, the entire earth with its forest appear to be wholly alone to me. Nay, even the three worlds!"

verses.devanagari:
अद्य नैरृतकन्यायां श्रोष्याम्यन्तःपुरे रवम्
करेणुसङ्घस्य यथा निनादं गिरिगह्वरे |
verses.iast:
adya nairṛtakanyāyāṃ śroṣyāmyantaḥpure ravam
kareṇusañghasya yathā ninādaṃ girigahvare |
verses.translation: "Now, I shall hear the hue and cry of the demon-maidens in the gynaecium, even as one would hear the roar of a troop of female-elephants in a mountain cave."

glosses.meaning: even as one would hear the roar

verses.devanagari:
यौवराज्यं च लङ्कां च रक्षांसि च परन्तप
मातरं मां च भार्यां च क्व गतोऽसि विहाय नः |
verses.iast:
yauvarājyaṃ ca lañkāṃ ca rakṣāṃsi ca parantapa
mātaraṃ māṃ ca bhāryāṃ ca kva gato'si vihāya naḥ |
verses.translation: "O destroyer of enemies! Where did you go leaving the rank of Prince Regent as also Lanka, the demons, your mother and myself, your wives and all of us."

glosses.meaning: O destroyer of enemies! kva = where
your right of succession to our kingdom

verses.devanagari:
मम नाम त्वया वीर गतस्य यमसादनम्
प्रेतकार्याणि कार्याणि विपरीते हि वर्तसे |
verses.iast:
mama nāma tvayā vIra gatasya yamasādanam
pretakāryāṇi kāryāṇi viparIte hi vartase |
verses.translation: "O hero! The obsequies rights in my honour ought to have been done by you, consequent upon my death in future. You are, however, following a reverse path."

glosses.meaning: you are indeed in a reverse path.

verses.devanagari:
स त्वं जीवति सुग्रीवे लक्ष्मणे च राघवे
मम शल्यमनुद्धृत्य क्व गतोऽसि विहाय नः |
verses.iast:
sa tvaṃ jIvati sugrIve lakṣmaṇe ca rāghave
mama śalyamanuddhṛtya kva gato'si vihāya naḥ |
verses.translation: "Deserting us without taking away my tormentation, while Sugreeva, lakshmana and Rama are still alive, where have you gone?"

verses.devanagari:
एवमादिविलापार्तं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
आविवेश महान्कोपः पुत्रव्यसनसम्भवः |
verses.iast:
evamādivilāpārtaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam
āviveśa mahānkopaḥ putravyasanasambhavaḥ |
verses.translation: A huge rage enveloped Ravana, the king of demons, born of his son's death, while he was feeling distressed through grief as aforesaid.

glosses.meaning: while he was feeling distressed through grief as aforesaid.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृत्या कोपनं ह्येनं पुत्रस्य पुनराधयः
दीप्तं संदीपयामासुर्घर्मेऽर्कमिव रश्मयः |
verses.iast:
prakṛtyā kopanaṃ hyenaṃ putrasya punarādhayaḥ
dīptaṃ sandīpayāmāsurgharme'rkamiva raśmayaḥ |
verses.translation: The anguishes occasioned by the death of his son, flared up further for him, who by his very nature, was wrathful, as rays of the sun flare up the blazing sun in summer.

verses.devanagari:
ललाटे भुकुटीभिश्च संगताभिर्व्यरोचत
यगान्ते सहनक्त्रस्तु महोर्मिभिरिवोदधिः |
verses.iast:
lalāṭe bhukuṭībhiśca saṅgatābhirvyarocata
yagānte sahanaktrastu mahormibhirivodadhiḥ |
verses.translation: With his eye brows joined together on his forehead, he shone brightly like an ocean, at the time of the dissolution of the world, with crocodiles and giant waves.

glosses.meaning: at the time of dissolution of the world

verses.devanagari:
कोपाद्विजृम्भमाणस्य वक्त्रद्व्यक्तमिव ज्वलन्
उत्पपात सधूमाग्निर्वृत्रस्य वदनादिव |
verses.iast:
kopādvijṛmbhamāṇasya vaktradvyaktamiva jvalan
utpapāta sadhūmāgnirvṛtrasya vadanādiva |
verses.translation: While he was yawning with anger; a fire with smoke, as though clearly burning, broke out from his mouth, as it did from the month of Vritra (in the former days).

glosses.meaning: as it did from the month

verses.devanagari:
स पुत्रवधसंतप्तः शूरः क्रोधवशं गतः
समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या वैदेह्या रोचयद्वधम् |
verses.iast:
sa putravadhasantaptaḥ śūraḥ krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ
samīkṣya rāvaṇo buddhyā vaidehyā rocayadvadham |
verses.translation: Afflicted with the grief of his son's killing, that valiant Ravana got wrapped up in wrath and pondering with his mind, craved for the killing of Seetha.

glosses.meaning: afflicted with the grief of his son's killing

verses.devanagari:
तस्य प्रकृत्या रक्ते च रक्ते क्रोधाग्निनापि च
रावणस्य महाघोरे दीप्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः |
verses.iast:
tasya prakṛtyā rakte ca rakte krodhāgnināpi ca
rāvaṇasya mahāghore dīpte netre babhūvatuḥ |
verses.translation: The dreadful eyes of that Ravana, which were red in colour by their very nature and were red even by the fire of his wrath, looked glittering.

glosses.meaning: even by the fire of wrath

verses.devanagari:
घोरं प्रकृत्या रूपं तत्तस्य क्रोधाग्निमूर्छितम्
बभूव रूपं रुद्रस्य क्रुद्धस्येव दुरासदम् |
verses.iast:
ghoraṃ prakṛtyā rUpaṃ tattasya krodhāgnimUrchitam
babhUva rUpaṃ rudrasya kruddhasyeva durāsadam |
verses.translation: That naturally terrific form of Ravana, filled with the fire of his wrath, became difficult to be approached, like the form of enraged Rudra the god of destruction.

glosses.meaning: filled with the fire of his wrath
like the form of enraged Rudra the god of destruction.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नस्रबिन्दवः
दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः |
verses.iast:
tasya kruddhasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannasrabindavaḥ
dIptābhyāmiva dIpābhyāṃ sārciṣaḥ snehabindavaḥ |
verses.translation: Drops of tears fell down from his enraged eyes, as drops of oil with flames fall down from blazing lamps.

verses.devanagari:
दन्तान्विदशतस्तस्य श्रूयते दशनस्वनः
यन्त्रस्यावेष्ट्यमानस्य महतो दानवैरिव |
verses.iast:
dantānvidaśatastasya śrUyate daśanasvanaḥ
yantrasyāveṣṭyamānasya mahato dānavairiva |
verses.translation: The sound of his teeth, produced from the friction of his teeth as he ground them, were heard like the noise of a large machine being bragged by the demons.

glosses.meaning: produced from the friction of his teeth as he ground them
like the noise of a large machine

verses.devanagari:
कालाग्निरिव संक्रुद्धो यां यां दिशमवैक्षत
तस्यां तस्यां भयत्रस्ता राक्षसाः संनिलिल्यिरे |
verses.iast:
kālāgniriva saṅkruddho yāṃ yāṃ diśamavaikṣata
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ bhayatrastā rākṣasāḥ saṃnililyire |
verses.translation: Trembling with fear, the demons hid themselves, in whichever quarter to which he directed his look, enraged as he was, like the fire of universal dissolution.

glosses.meaning: to which he directed his look
like the fire of universal dissolution.

verses.devanagari:
तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं चराचरचिखादिषुम्
वीक्षमाणं दिशः सर्वा राक्षसा नोपचक्रमुः |
verses.iast:
tamantakamiva kruddhaṃ carācaracikhādiṣum
vIkṣamāṇaṃ diśaḥ sarvā rākṣasā nopacakramuḥ |
verses.translation: Demons could not go towards Ravana, who was looking at all the four quarters, like the enraged Yama the god of Death, who wants to devour both the mobile and the immobile creatures.

glosses.meaning: like the enraged Yama the god of Death
who wants to devour mobile and immobile creatures.

verses.devanagari:
ततः परमसंक्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये संस्तम्भयिषुराहवे |
verses.iast:
tataḥ paramasaṅkruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
abravIdrakṣasāṃ madhye saṃstambhayiṣurāhave |
verses.translation: Desirous of posting the demons to the battle-field, Ravana the king of demons, who was very much enraged, then spoke as follows, in their midst:

verses.devanagari:
मया वर्षसहस्राणि चरित्वा परमं तपः
तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु स्वयम्भूः परितोषितः |
verses.iast:
mayā varṣasahasrāṇi caritvā paramaṃ tapaḥ
teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu svayambhUḥ paritoṣitaḥ |
verses.translation: "Brahma the lord of creation was gratified by me, by performing a stupendous austerity for thousands of years, at the conclusion of those austerities."

glosses.meaning: at the conclusion of those austerities.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यैव तपसो व्युष्ट्या प्रसादाच्च स्वयम्भुवः
नासुरेभ्यो न देवेभ्यो भयं मम कदा चन |
verses.iast:
tasyaiva tapaso vyuṣṭyā prasādācca svayambhuvaḥ
nāsurebhyo na devebhyo bhayaṃ mama kadā cana |
verses.translation: "As a consequence of that austerity alone and by the grace of Brahma the lord of creation, there was never a fear for me either from the demons or from the celestials."

glosses.meaning: of Brahma the lord of creation

verses.devanagari:
कवचं ब्रह्मदत्तं मे यदादित्यसमप्रभम्
देवासुरविमर्देषु न भिन्नं वज्रशक्तिभिः |
verses.iast:
kavacaṃ brahmadattaṃ me yadādityasamaprabham
devāsuravimardeṣu na bhinnaṃ vajraśaktibhiḥ |
verses.translation: "In the course of combats with the gods and demons, the armour gifted to me by Brahma, the lord of creation, which is as brilliant as the sun, could not be mutilated by those who held the thunderbolt in their fists."

glosses.meaning: in the battles between the celestials and demons
which was as brilliant as the sun
gifted by Brahma the lord of creation

verses.devanagari:
तेन मामद्य संयुक्तं रथस्थमिह संयुगे
प्रतीयात्कोऽद्य मामाजौ साक्षादपि पुरन्दरः |
verses.iast:
tena māmadya saṃyuktaṃ rathasthamiha saṃyuge
pratIyātko'dya māmājau sākṣādapi purandaraḥ |
verses.translation: "Who will, be it Indra himself, dare to attack me on the battle-field now, when mounted on chariot on this field of battle, and duly wearing the aforesaid armour?"

verses.devanagari:
यत्तदाभिप्रसन्नेन सशरं कार्मुकं महत्
देवासुरविमर्देषु मम दत्तं स्वयम्भुवा |
अद्य तूर्यशतैर्भीमं धनुरुत्थाप्यतां मम
रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव वधाय परमाहवे |
verses.iast:
yattadābhiprasannena saśaraṃ kārmukaṃ mahat
devāsuravimardeṣu mama dattaṃ svayambhuvā |
adya tUryaśatairbhImaṃ dhanurutthāpyatāṃ mama
rāmalakṣmaṇayoreva vadhāya paramāhave |
verses.translation: "Let that large bow of mine, which was given at that time to me along with arrows by the gracious Brahma the lord of creation, on the occasion of my combat between gods and demons, be taken out today to the accompaniment of a band of musical instruments, for the purpose of killing Rama and Lakshmana in the great battle."

glosses.meaning: in the combat between gods and demons
with a band of musical instruments

verses.devanagari:
स पुत्रवधसन्तप्तः शूरः क्रोधवशं गतः
समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या सीतां हन्तुं व्यवस्यत |
verses.iast:
sa putravadhasantaptaḥ śUraḥ krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ
samIkṣya rāvaṇo buddhyā sItāṃ hantuṃ vyavasyata |
verses.translation: That cruel Ravana, afflicted as he was with grief at the killing of his son, was subjected to anger and deeply pondering with his mind, decided kill Seetha.

glosses.meaning: afflicted with grief at the killing of his son

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यवेक्ष्य तु ताम्राक्षः सुघोरो घोरदर्शनान्
दीनो दीनस्वरान्सर्वांस्तानुवाच निशाचरान् |
verses.iast:
pratyavekṣya tu tāmrākṣaḥ sughoro ghoradarśanān
dIno dInasvarānsarvāṃstānuvāca niśācarān |
verses.translation: Looking fixedly with blood-red eyes on all those demons, who were making miserable sounds, that very awful Ravana for his part, who had assumed a terrible appearance, though feeling distressed, spoke to them as follows:

glosses.meaning: the very awful Ravana for his part
who had assumed a terrible appearance

verses.devanagari:
मायया मम वत्सेन वंचनार्थं वनौकसाम्
किं चिदेव हतं तत्र सीतेयमिति दर्शितम् |
verses.iast:
māyayā mama vatsena vañcanārthaṃ vanaukasām
kiṃ cideva hataṃ tatra sIteyamiti darśitam |
verses.translation: "In order to hoodwink the monkeys, something which had been killed there, was shown, by taking recourse to conjuring tricks, as Seetha, by my child (Indrajit)"

verses.devanagari:
तदिदं तथ्यमेवाहं करिष्ये प्रियमात्मनः
वैदेहीं नाशयिष्यामि क्षत्रबन्धुमनुव्रताम् |
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सचिवान्खड्गमाशु परामृशत्
verses.iast:
tadidaṃ tathyamevāhaṃ kariṣye priyamātmanaḥ
vaidehIṃ nāśayiṣyāmi kṣatrabandhumanuvratām |
ityevamuktvā sacivānkhaḍgamāśu parāmṛśat
verses.translation: "I shall make that hoax into a hard reality, which is pleasing to me. I shall destroy Seetha, who is devoted to Rama, a bad warrior". Thus speaking to his counsellors, he swiftly drew his sword.

verses.devanagari:
उत्प्लुत्य गुणसम्पन्नं विमलाम्बरवर्चसं |
निष्पपात स वेगेन सभायाः सचिवैर्वृतः
रावणः पुत्रशोकेन भृशमाकुलचेतनः |
संक्रुद्धः खड्गमादाय सहसा यत्र मैथिली
verses.iast:
utplutya guṇasampannaṃ vimalāmbaravarcasaṃ |
niṣpapāta sa vegena sabhāyāḥ sacivairvṛtaḥ
rāvaṇaḥ putraśokena bhṛśamākulacetanaḥ |
saṅkruddhaḥ khaḍgamādāya sahasā yatra maithilI
verses.translation: The enraged Ravana, who was very much agitated in mind because of the grief for his son's death, springing up suddenly and taking his excellent sword, having the dazzle of a clear sky, sallied forth from the assembly hall along with his ministers swiftly and quickly to the place where Seetha was.

glosses.meaning: who was very much agitated in mind
because of the grief for his son's death
springing up suddenly aadaaya = and taking
with the dazzle of a clear sky

verses.devanagari:
व्रजन्तं राक्षसं प्रेक्ष्य सिंहनादं विचुक्रुशुः |
ऊचुश्चान्योन्यमालिङ्ग्य संक्रुद्धं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसाः
verses.iast:
vrajantaṃ rākṣasaṃ prekṣya siṃhanādaṃ vicukruśuḥ |
Ucuścānyonyamāliṇ^gya saṅkruddhaṃ prekṣya rākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Ravana going, his followers emitted a lion's roar. Seeing the enraged Ravana and embracing each other, they spoke as follows:

verses.devanagari:
अद्यैनं तावुभौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ प्रव्यथिष्यतः |
लोकपाला हि चत्वारः क्रुद्धेनानेन तर्जिताः
बहवः शत्रवश्चान्ये संयुगेष्वभिपातिताः |
verses.iast:
adyainaṃ tāvubhau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau pravyathiṣyataḥ |
lokapālā hi catvāraḥ kruddhenānena tarjitāḥ
bahavaḥ śatravaścānye saṃyugeṣvabhipātitāḥ |
verses.translation: "Both those brothers (Rama and Lakshmana), on seeing him now in fury, will get perturbed. Indeed even the four guardians of the world had been frightened by him, who was in fury. Many other enemies were also frightened by him in various battles."

verses.devanagari:
त्रिषु लोकेषु रत्नानि भुङ्क्ते चाहृत्य रावणः
विक्रमे च बले चैव नास्त्यस्य सदृशो भुवि |
verses.iast:
triṣu lokeṣu ratnāni bhuṇ^kte cāhṛtya rāvaṇaḥ
vikrame ca bale caiva nāstyasya sadṛśo bhuvi |
verses.translation: "Fetching precious things existing in all the three worlds, Ravana enjoys them. No one on the earth is equal to him in strength and prowess."

verses.devanagari:
तेषां संजल्पमानानामशोकवनिकां गताम्
अभिदुद्राव वैदेहीं रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः |
verses.iast:
teṣāṃ sañjalpamānānāmaśokavanikāṃ gatām
abhidudrāva vaidehIṃ rāvaṇaḥ krodhamUrchitaḥ |
verses.translation: While those demons were thus talking, Ravana who was excited with fury, rushed towards Seetha, who was present in the Ashoka grove.

glosses.meaning: while the demons were thus talking
who was present ashoka vanikaam = in the Ashoka grove.

verses.devanagari:
वार्यमाणः सुसंक्रुद्धः सुहृद्भिर्हितबुद्धिभिः
अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धः खे ग्रहो रोहिणीम् इव |
verses.iast:
vāryamāṇaḥ susaṅkruddhaḥ suhṛdbhirhitabuddhibhiḥ
abhyadhāvata saṅkruddhaḥ khe graho rohiṇIm iva |
verses.translation: Though being kept back by his companions whose minds were set on his welfare, Ravana who was very much enraged, rushed like Mars, in the sky, which would rush towards the constellation, Rohini in fury.

glosses.meaning: by his companions hitabuddhibhiH = whose minds were set on his welfare

verses.devanagari:
मैथिली रक्ष्यमाणा तु राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता
ददर्श राक्षसं क्रुद्धं निस्त्रिंशवरधारिणम् |
verses.iast:
maithilI rakṣyamāṇā tu rākṣasIbhiraninditā
dadarśa rākṣasaṃ kruddhaṃ nistriṃśavaradhāriṇam |
verses.translation: The faultless Seetha for her part, who was being guarded by female demons, saw the enraged Ravana who was bearing an excellent sword.

verses.devanagari:
तं निशाम्य सनिस्त्रिंशं व्यथिता जनकात्मजा
निवार्यमाणं बहुशः सुहृद्भिरनिवर्तिनम् |
verses.iast:
taṃ niśāmya sanistriṃśaṃ vyathitā janakātmajā
nivāryamāṇaṃ bahuśaḥ suhṛdbhiranivartinam |
verses.translation: Seetha was perturbed in seeing him, bearing sword and who was not going back eventhough being kept back in many ways by his friends.

glosses.meaning: and who was not going back
eventhough being kept back bahushaH = in many ways

verses.devanagari:
सीता दुःखसमाविष्टा विलपन्तीदमब्रवीत्
यथायं मामभिक्रुद्धः समभिद्रवति स्वयम् |
वधिष्यति सनाथां मामनाथामिव दुर्मतिः
verses.iast:
sītā duḥkhasamāviṣṭā vilapantīdamabravīt
yathāyaṃ māmabhikruddhaḥ samabhidravati svayam |
vadhiṣyati sanāthāṃ māmanāthāmiva durmatiḥ
verses.translation: Filled with sorrow and lamenting, Seetha said to herself as follows: "From the manner in which this fellow himself is rushing towards me in fury, I fear the evil-minded demon is going to kill me, to make me husband-less, even though I have a husband".

glosses.meaning: as if to make me husband-less.

verses.devanagari:
बहुशश्चोदयामास भर्तारं मामनुव्रताम् |
भार्या भव रमस्येति प्रत्याख्यातो ध्रुवं मया
सोऽयं मामनुपस्थानाद् व्यक्तं नैराश्यमागतः |
क्रोधमोहसमाविष्टो व्यक्तं मां हन्तुमुद्यतः
verses.iast:
bahuśaścodayāmāsa bhartāraṃ māmanuvratām |
bhāryā bhava ramasyeti pratyākhyāto dhruvaṃ mayā
so'yaṃ māmanupasthānād vyaktaṃ nairāśyamāgataḥ |
krodhamohasamāviṣṭo vyaktaṃ māṃ hantumudyataḥ
verses.translation: "He incited me several times, devoted as I am to my husband, saying 'Be my consort!'. He was refused firmly by me. Having been evidently afflicted with despair on my refusing to wait upon him, he is surely intent to kill me, filled as he was with anger and infatuation."

glosses.meaning: on my refusing to wait upon him
filled as he was with anger and infatuation.

verses.devanagari:
अथ वा तौ नरव्याघ्रौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |
मन्निमित्तमनार्येण समरेऽद्य निपातितौ
verses.iast:
atha vā tau naravyāghrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau |
mannimittamanāryeṇa samare'dya nipātitau
verses.translation: "Otherwise, that vulgar demon might have killed those brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, the foremost of men, today in battle, because of me."

verses.devanagari:
भैरवो हि महान्नादो राक्षसानां श्रुतो मया |
बहूनामिह हृष्टानां तथा विक्रोशतां प्रियम्
verses.iast:
bhairavo hi mahānnādo rākṣasānāṃ śruto mayā |
bahūnāmiha hṛṣṭānāṃ tathā vikrośatāṃ priyam
verses.translation: "Here, I just heard a terrific great noise of a multitude of demons, who have been jubilant and roaring about a pleasant happening."

verses.devanagari:
अहो धिन्मन्निमित्तोऽयं विनाशो राजपुत्रयोः |
अथवा पुत्रशोकेन अहत्वा रामलक्ष्मणौ
विधमिष्यति मां रौद्रो राक्षसः पापनिश्चयः |
verses.iast:
aho dhinmannimitto'yaṃ vināśo rājaputrayoḥ |
athavā putraśokena ahatvā rāmalakṣmaṇau
vidhamiṣyati māṃ raudro rākṣasaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ |
verses.translation: "Alas! Woe is me, if that destruction of the two princes was brought about because of me. Otherwise, the terrific demon of a sinful resolve, having not been able to kill Rama and Lakshmana, is going to kill, me, because of the grief over his son's death."

glosses.meaning: was brought about because of me
having not been able to kill
because of the grief over his son's death.

verses.devanagari:
हनूमतो हि तद्वाक्यं न कृतं क्षुद्रया मया
यद्यहं तस्य पृष्ठेन तदायासमनिन्दिता |
नाद्यैवमनुशोचेयं भर्तुरंकगता सती
verses.iast:
hanUmato hi tadvākyaṃ na kṛtaṃ kṣudrayā mayā
yadyahaṃ tasya pṛṣṭhena tadāyāsamaninditā |
nādyaivamanuśoceyaṃ bharturaṅkagatā satI
verses.translation: "Those words of Hanuma were not acted upon by me, having a low mind. If I left on that day on his back, though not won back by my husband, I would not have grieved like this today, as I should be resting on the lap of my husband (in that case)."

glosses.meaning: though not won back (by my husband)
as I am doing in his manner today
as I should be resting on the lap of my husband (in that case).

verses.devanagari:
मन्ये तु हृदयं तस्याः कौसल्यायाः फलिष्यति |
एकपुत्रा यदा पुत्रं विनष्टं श्रोष्यते युधि
verses.iast:
manye tu hṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ kausalyāyāḥ phaliṣyati |
ekaputrā yadā putraṃ vinaṣṭaṃ śroṣyate yudhi
verses.translation: "I think that the heart of that Kausalya will get burst, when the lady, who had only one son, hears of her son having been killed in battle."

verses.devanagari:
सा हि जन्म च बाल्यं च यौवनं च महात्मनः |
धर्मकार्याणि रूपं च रुदती संस्रमिष्यति
verses.iast:
sā hi janma ca bālyaṃ ca yauvanaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ |
dharmakāryāṇi rUpaṃ ca rudatI saṃsramiṣyati
verses.translation: "While lamenting, Kausalya will vividly recall about the birth, childhood, youth, the righteous acts and the handsome form of the great-souled Rama."

verses.devanagari:
निराशा निहते पुत्रे दत्त्वा श्राद्धमचेतना |
अग्निमारोक्ष्यते नूनमपो वापि प्रवेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
nirāśā nihate putre dattvā śrāddhamacetanā |
agnimārokṣyate nUnamapo vāpi pravekṣyati
verses.translation: "Having observed a ceremony in honour of her deceased son and getting despondent and unconscious, Kausalya will surely enter the flame or be drowned in water."

glosses.meaning: a ceremony in honour of her dead son

verses.devanagari:
धिगस्तु कुब्जामसतीं मन्थरां पापनिश्चयाम् |
यन्निमित्तमिदं दुःखं कौसल्या प्रतिपत्स्यते
verses.iast:
dhigastu kubjāmasatIṃ mantharāṃ pāpaniścayām |
yannimittamidaṃ duḥkhaṃ kausalyā pratipatsyate
verses.translation: "Woe be to the unfaithful hunch-back Manthara, of sinful resolve, on whose consequence, Kausalya will get this grief."

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवं मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा विलपन्तीं तपस्विनीम् |
रोहिणीमिव चन्द्रेण विना ग्रहवशं गताम्
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तस्य अमात्यः शीलवान् शुचिः |
सुपार्श्वो नाम मेधावी रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्
निवार्यमाणं सचिवैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
ityevaṃ maithilIṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapantIṃ tapasvinIm |
rohiṇImiva candreṇa vinā grahavaśaṃ gatām
etasminnantare tasya amātyaḥ śīlavān śuciḥ |
supārśvo nāma medhāvI rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram
nivāryamāṇaṃ sacivairidaṃ vacanamabravIt |
verses.translation: Seeing Seetha miserably weeping in that manner like Rohini (the deity presiding over a constellation of this name), fallen under the sway of the planet Mars, when away of the moon-god (her husband), a minister called Suparshva, a good-natured, upright and highly intelligent demon, even though restrained by other ministers, spoke the following words Ravana, the foremost of demons:

glosses.meaning: like Rohini (the deity presiding over a constellation of this name)
fallen under the sway of the planet Mars
when away of the moon-god (her husband)

verses.devanagari:
कथं नाम दशग्रीव साक्षाद्वैश्रवणानुज
हन्तुमिच्छसि वैदेहीं क्रोधाद्धर्ममपास्य हि |
verses.iast:
kathaṃ nāma daśagrIva sākṣādvaiśravaṇānuja
hantumicchasi vaidehIṃ krodhāddharmamapāsya hi |
verses.translation: "O Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera himself! How do you wish to kill Seetha, abandoning your righteousness, in a bout of anger?"

verses.devanagari:
वेद विद्याव्रत स्नातः स्वधर्मनिरतः सदा
स्त्रियाः कस्माद्वधं वीर मन्यसे राक्षसेश्वर |
verses.iast:
veda vidyāvrata snātaḥ svadharmanirataḥ sadā
striyāḥ kasmādvadhaṃ vIra manyase rākṣaseśvara |
verses.translation: "O valiant king of demons! Why are you thinking of destroying a lady, ever since you completed the vow of celibacy essential for a study of the Vedic lore and were devoted to your own duty?"

glosses.meaning: ever since you completed the vow of celibacy essential for a study of the Vedic lore
were devoted to your own duty?

verses.devanagari:
मैथिलीं रूपसम्पन्नां प्रत्यवेक्षस्व पार्थिव
तस्मिन्नेव सहास्माभी राघवे क्रोधमुत्सृज |
verses.iast:
maithilIṃ rUpasampannāṃ pratyavekṣasva pārthiva
tasminneva sahāsmābhI rāghave krodhamutsṛja |
verses.translation: "O king! Behold at Seetha, endowed, as she is, with beauty. Together with us, release your anger, in battle, on Rama alone."

verses.devanagari:
अभ्युत्थानं त्वमद्यैव कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दशीम्
कृत्वा निर्याह्यमावास्यां विजयाय बलैर्वृतः |
verses.iast:
abhyutthānaṃ tvamadyaiva kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśIm
kṛtvā niryāhyamāvāsyāṃ vijayāya balairvṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: "Making yourself ready today itself, the fourteenth day of the dark half of this month, you along with the armies, sally forth tomorrow, the moonless day, to victory."

glosses.meaning: the fourteenth day of the dark half of this month

verses.devanagari:
शूरो धीमान्रथी खड्गी रथप्रवरमास्थितः
हत्वा दाशरथिं रामं भवान्प्राप्स्यति मैथिलीम् |
verses.iast:
śUro dhImānrathI khaḍgI rathapravaramāsthitaḥ
hatvā dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ bhavānprāpsyati maithilIm |
verses.translation: "As a valiant and shrewd chariot-warrior, fighting with a sword, in the foremost of your chariots, you can fetch Seetha by killing Rama, the son of Dasaratha."

glosses.meaning: in the foremost of your chariots

verses.devanagari:
स तद्दुरात्मा सुहृदा निवेदितं |
वचः सुधर्म्यं प्रतिगृह्य रावणः |
गृहं जगामाथ ततश्च वीर्यवान् |
पुनः सभां च प्रययौ सुहृद्वृतः
verses.iast:
sa taddurātmā suhṛdā niveditaṃ |
vacaḥ sudharmyaṃ pratigṛhya rāvaṇaḥ |
gṛhaṃ jagāmātha tataśca vIryavān |
punaḥ sabhāṃ ca prayayau suhṛdvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Accepting that advice, endowed with justice, tendered by a friend, the evil-minded Ravana went to his palace. Thereafter, that valiant Ravana, along with his friends, again went to his assembly hall from there.
